title: cleome pakistanica
intro: Cleome pakistanica, commonly known as the Pakistan spider flower, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Cleomaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable remedy in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Cleome pakistanica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
